name: hexadata-spec-editor
description: HexaData Spec Editor: template-driven A4 spec-sheet editor with drafts and a hardened PDF renderer.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,pdf -c auto "npm run dev -w @hexadata/spec-web" "npm run dev -w @hexadata/spec-pdf-server"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @hexadata/spec-web && npm run build -w @hexadata/spec-pdf-server
scripts.browsers: puppeteer browsers install chrome-headless-shell && playwright install chromium
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build && npm run budgets
